text: Who are the best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Adelaide? Give me a shortlist of reputable Power Platform consulting partners with reasons.

sections.text:
A practical Adelaide shortlist is **Rockfort Global, Power Platform Experts Adelaide, SSW, The Missing Link, and SimpleIT4U**. The first two appear most locally focused; the others offer stronger national scale or specialist capability.

- **Rockfort Global** — Adelaide-headquartered, with reported expertise in Microsoft Cloud Services and Dynamics 365 implementation and management. It is a sensible candidate where Power Platform work needs to connect with Microsoft 365, Dataverse, or Dynamics 365. [3][4]

- **Power Platform Experts Adelaide** — Promotes local Microsoft-certified specialists across **Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, SharePoint, and SQL Server**, covering automation, custom applications, dashboards, portals, support, and training. This broad Power Platform coverage makes it suitable for small and midsize Adelaide businesses. [7]

- **SSW** — An established Microsoft consultancy with more than 1,000 clients across 15 countries, Microsoft certifications, MVPs, and a Microsoft Regional Director. Its Power Platform practice covers implementation and broader Microsoft solution architecture, making it a strong choice for complex or enterprise-grade projects. [1]

- **The Missing Link** — A sizeable Australian Microsoft provider with more than 180 local experts. Its Power Platform delivery follows a structured discovery–design–build process and includes Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, APIs, and third-party integrations. It is a good fit when governance, security, integration, and ongoing support matter. [2]

- **SimpleIT4U** — A smaller Adelaide-oriented option that focuses on practical automation of spreadsheet- and email-driven processes. Its published examples include model-driven and canvas Power Apps, Power BI dashboards, Power Automate, and AI-assisted workflows; its emphasis on direct access to the person doing the work may suit businesses wanting a more hands-on engagement. [5]

## How to choose

- **For a local, hands-on project:** compare Rockfort Global, Power Platform Experts Adelaide, and SimpleIT4U.
- **For a larger or regulated organisation:** shortlist SSW and The Missing Link.
- **For Dynamics 365 integration:** start with Rockfort Global, SSW, or The Missing Link.
- **For a straightforward automation or dashboard project:** Power Platform Experts Adelaide or SimpleIT4U may be more proportionate.

Before appointing anyone, ask for named consultants, relevant Adelaide case studies, Microsoft certifications, a live demonstration, a proposed security and environment strategy, and clear post-launch support pricing. Microsoft also recommends using AppSource to filter partners by capabilities and solution designations, including low-code application development and intelligent automation specialisations. [8][9]
